rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadIntro: Hubie surfs from the beach to the island, buoy by buoy. A shark waits under some of the lanes. Every lane he crosses raises the multiplier; a shark ends the round and the bet is lost.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadHow: Choose a difficulty and a bet, press Bet, then ride one lane at a time. Cash out after any lane you crossed to take the bet times the multiplier shown. Cross every lane and Hubie reaches the island party: the round cashes out by itself at the top multiplier.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadAuto: Auto rides the same number of lanes every round and cashes out there — set Lanes, or tap the buoy he should stop at.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadReturn: Theoretical RTP before rounding and any payout cap: {pct}% (1% house edge). A capped payout can reduce the return. After k lanes with m sharks the multiplier is 0.99 × C(25, k) / C(25 − m, k), the fair price of surviving k lanes, less 1%. Payouts are rounded down to the wallet’s smallest unit.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadMaxWin: A lane that would take the win past the maximum win is not offered: cash out instead. A round whose first lane would already pass it does not start.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadReload: A round in play stays open on the server: reload the game and it carries on where it stood.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadIdle: A round left without a decision for 24 hours is finished by the server: with lanes crossed it is cashed out at its value; with none, the first lane is ridden and, if safe, cashed out.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadMaxWinCap: A round wins at most {cap} above its stake.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadFreeRound: A bet of 0 plays a free round — nothing is staked, nothing is paid; the sharks are still placed.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRoadFair: The sharks are placed before you bet, from HMAC-SHA256(server seed, client seed:nonce) — the public Mines calculators’ draw for 25 tiles, lane = tile + 1. The server seed’s hash is shown up front and the seed is revealed when you rotate the pair: check any round in the fairness window.
